title: Client-only UI requests: different default icons, blank name that opens the keyboard
problem: Informal feedback (REP-045): every player has the same icon; the name defaults to "You" and the owner wants it blank with the keyboard popping up. By code: the default avatar is HUMAN_AVATARS[0] unless a player picks another in the online lobby (Online.tsx), and the name falls back to "You" (store.ts).
scope: Each seat gets a different default icon (the first unused one) in online rooms and on one device
New-game and online name fields start blank, take focus and open the keyboard; if left blank the game still needs a name, so a fallback is shown and recorded
No server or protocol change in this plan; if the room needs a server change for icons, split it into PLAN-023
exclusions: Renaming inside a room after joining (PLAN-023)

acceptance.text: Four seats show four different icons by default (device test, one device and an online room)
Name field is blank and the keyboard opens on Android Chrome and iPhone Safari
Saved names and old saves still load; verify and verify:full pass
